rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body (lines 1-83, above the maintainer fence) carries no M[0-9] or module-name references — checked by grep. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test and the truth clause.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Six headers: 'Passing is not proof', 'The judge needs calibrating against your labels', 'Gates decay', 'One run is a sample', 'Change on recurrence, not on noise', 'The delegation frontier'. Each names the ONE claim/thing the slide argues (squint test) and each is licensed by its own bullets at the strength claimed (truth clause) -- no dropped qualifiers, no unsupported universals. No two headers repeat. 'The delegation frontier' names the figure, not an empty container.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded (~210 words, ≤6 bullets), not just its header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Measured per-slide word counts (SVG figure excluded per rule): Passing is not proof 135w/3 bullets; The judge needs calibrating 169w/3; Gates decay 133w/3; One run is a sample 126w/3; Change on recurrence 143w/3; The delegation frontier 139w/3. All six under the 210w ceiling and at 3 bullets, well under the 6-bullet cap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body teaches the work; trainer manages the room outside text.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for authored conversation cues ('discuss with', 'take 90 seconds', 'share what you', 'tell the room', 'compare with the person') across the file returns no matches. Body stays on the work (the gate's fallibility, the frontier map) throughout; no cohort-management sentences.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named (mood-floor 8+/10 on teaching beats).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Trace: phase 1 mood_score 8, close mood_score 9 -- both teaching beats (this whole lecture is a teaching beat, no setup/launch beat to exempt) at or above the 8-floor. mood_note confirms doubt stays open through the close ('Doubt open, exactly per contract'), matching the maintainer-stated mood contract.

Trace mood register throughout is not-knowing ('my M5 run's placement still an open question the return will answer', 'I can feel there's a hopeful version of this map and the deck refuses to give it to me yet'), never having-done-wrong. Body text mirrors this: 'A gate only means what the gate can see' frames doubt about the check, not shame about the student's work.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers 'Passing is not proof' and 'Gates decay' are failure-named, but the maintainer block explicitly invokes the named-canonical-result carve-out and corpus precedent: 'Corpus precedent ships failure-named: Gates decay, Passing is not proof, Why mostly-right fails.' Discipline-lead is satisfied at body level -- each slide's bullets teach the positive countermove (hand-labels, hold-outs, repeated runs, react-on-recurrence), not just the failure.
